name: data-platform-database-async-immediate-dml-runtime

evidence.notes: Immediate insert family is directly executed through local Account DML.
Single-record immediate insert returns a successful local result and persists the Account.
List immediate insert returns two ordered successful local results and persists both Accounts.
Immediate update family is directly executed through local Account DML.
Single-record immediate update returns a successful local result and fresh persisted state.
List immediate update returns two ordered successful local results and fresh persisted state.
Immediate delete family is directly executed through local Account DML.
Single-record immediate delete returns a successful local result and marks the Account deleted.
List immediate delete returns two ordered successful local results and marks both Accounts deleted.
Async save-result lookup family is directly executed against a materialized local result.
Object async save-result lookup returns a successful local SaveResult with the inserted Id.
Typed Database.SaveResult async lookup returns a successful local SaveResult.
Async delete-result lookup family is directly executed against a materialized local result.
Object async delete-result lookup returns a successful local DeleteResult.
Typed Database.DeleteResult async lookup returns a successful local DeleteResult.

args: Account asyncAccount = new Account(Name = 'Async'); Object asyncResult = Database.insertAsync(asyncAccount); Object saved = Database.getAsyncSaveResult(asyncResult); Database.SaveResult savedTyped = Database.getAsyncSaveResult((Database.SaveResult)asyncResult); System.assert(saved.isSuccess()); System.assert(savedTyped.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(asyncAccount.Id, saved.getId()); Object bareInsert = Database.insertImmediate(new Account(Name = 'Immediate Bare')); System.assert(bareInsert.isSuccess()); Account bareA = new Account(Name = 'Immediate Bare A'); Account bareB = new Account(Name = 'Immediate Bare B'); List<Object> bareInsertList = Database.insertImmediate(new List<Account>{bareA, bareB}); System.assertEquals(2, bareInsertList.size()); System.assert(bareInsertList[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(bareInsertList[1].isSuccess()); Account bareUpdated = new Account(Id = bareInsert.getId(), Name = 'Immediate Bare Updated'); Object bareUpdate = Database.updateImmediate(bareUpdated); System.assert(bareUpdate.isSuccess()); bareA.Name = 'Immediate Bare A Updated'; bareB.Name = 'Immediate Bare B Updated'; List<Object> bareUpdateList = Database.updateImmediate(new List<Account>{bareA, bareB}); System.assertEquals(2, bareUpdateList.size()); System.assert(bareUpdateList[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(bareUpdateList[1].isSuccess()); Account deleteAsyncTarget = new Account(Name = 'Async Delete'); insert deleteAsyncTarget; Object deleteResult = Database.deleteAsync(deleteAsyncTarget); Object deleted = Database.getAsyncDeleteResult(deleteResult); Database.DeleteResult deletedTyped = Database.getAsyncDeleteResult((Database.DeleteResult)deleteResult); System.assert(deleted.isSuccess()); System.assert(deletedTyped.isSuccess()); Object bareDelete = Database.deleteImmediate(new Account(Id = bareInsert.getId())); System.assert(bareDelete.isSuccess()); List<Object> bareDeleteList = Database.deleteImmediate(new List<Account>{new Account(Id = bareA.Id), new Account(Id = bareB.Id)}); System.assertEquals(2, bareDeleteList.size()); System.assert(bareDeleteList[0].isSuccess()); System.assert(bareDeleteList[1].isSuccess()); List<Account> rows = [SELECT Id, Name, IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id IN :new Set<Id>{bareInsert.getId(), bareA.Id, bareB.Id, deleteAsyncTarget.Id} ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(4, rows.size()); Map<Id, Account> byId = new Map<Id, Account>(rows); System.assertEquals('Immediate Bare Updated', byId.get(bareInsert.getId()).Name); System.assertEquals('Immediate Bare A Updated', byId.get(bareA.Id).Name); System.assertEquals('Immediate Bare B Updated', byId.get(bareB.Id).Name); System.assert(byId.get(bareInsert.getId()).IsDeleted); System.assert(byId.get(bareA.Id).IsDeleted); System.assert(byId.get(bareB.Id).IsDeleted); System.assert(byId.get(deleteAsyncTarget.Id).IsDeleted);

salesforceExclusionReason: Salesforce API 67 requires virtual sObjects for Database async/immediate external-object APIs; this fixture intentionally exercises local deterministic aliases on Account.
